Settings - Board - before / after / diff

improved

The 'Folders the board scans' block must read as one control group: a visible gap between each root's path, its state chip and its remove control, and the add-folder field given the width its row has left so its hint is readable. 9 surface pairs: 1440x900, 1280x800, 1024x768 x open, presets, search. Same steps and asserts as the baseline. Tests: 21 pass / 0 fail, exit 0; 22 pass / 0 fail, exit 0.
